items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: The recording liner notes credit you, Frank Brown and R.I. O'Nan as the co-composers of this.

ctx.x: were better for him to play, and the band was backing him better, and everything like that. And it shows in 'Grooving,' was one of the things we -- things were quite a hit with the band. We used this arrangement a lot on the show. It was a show tune. We used to open with this a lot. And it went over real big, because Louie was spotted -- was different -- and it showed him off much better.
The recording liner notes credit you, Frank Brown and R.I. O'Nan as the co-composers of this.
